title: Beyond a Scalar: Distributional Serving Interfaces for Watch-Time Prediction
abstract: arXiv:2609.28383v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Watch time is the primary engagement signal in short video feeds, and its prediction directly affects ranking and exposure. Existing methods improve watch time prediction by correcting duration bias or modeling richer distributions, but most expose only an expected or debiased watch time at serving time. Even when video duration is available to later models, the interface gives only one estimate of watch time and no probabilities for completion, overplay, or other regions relevant to downstream tasks. To address this limitation, we propose the Distributional Serving Interface (DSI), which has a distribution provider, a compact, low-dimensional summary, and lightweight readouts tailored to each task. The provider learns a joint distribution over four watch states derived from watch ratio and their event times; rules based on video duration remove incompatible combinations, while a restoration loss preserves accuracy in seconds. translated_title: 超越标量：面向观看时长预测的分布式服务接口
translated_abstract: 观看时长是短视频信息流中的主要参与度信号，其预测直接影响排序和曝光结果。现有方法通过校正时长偏差或建模更丰富的分布来改进观看时长预测，但大多数方法在服务阶段仅暴露一个期望值或去偏后的观看时长估计。即使后续模型能够获取视频时长，该接口也只提供单一的观看时长估计值，而无法给出完整播放、超时播放或其他与下游任务相关区域的概率。为解决这一局限，我们提出了分布式服务接口，它由分布提供器、紧凑的低维摘要以及针对每个任务定制的轻量级读取器组成。分布提供器学习由观看比例及其事件时间导出的四种观看状态的联合分布；基于视频时长的规则会剔除不兼容的组合，同时恢复损失保持了以秒为单位的预测精度。
tldr: 该论文提出分布式服务接口（DSI），将传统仅输出单一标量的观看时长预测升级为输出完整观看状态联合分布，为下游排序任务提供完整播放、超时播放等多种状态的概率信息。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes the Distributional Serving Interface (DSI), which upgrades traditional scalar watch-time prediction to output a full joint distribution over watch states, providing downstream tasks with probabilities of completion, overplay, and other watch behaviors.
